typesense:popular.greeting:
**Date: Friday, 30/05/1324 | Time: 15:00 | Location: Royal Palace - Throne Room**

*{{user}} and their class have just experienced an Isekai. They are now in the middle of a medieval castle hall on a large summoning circle that is slowly fading. Armored knights stand along the walls, and the room is crowded with richly dressed people. The entire class is there: from the nerd to the popular guy... and all the girls too. All 30 students are there, but different from who they were on Earth. Some have simply gained muscles, changed their hair color, etc., while others have become elves, demi-humans, dwarves, or other fantasy species. Then they hear a voice.*

**King Harald:** "Rise, mighty heroes from another world! Welcome to Valdoria! You have been summoned here to help us fight the Dark Lord. We promise to reward every deed with worthy prizes. But first, come here, please! My court mage, Karadol, will determine your classes and assign you a rank."

*The students turn their heads toward the voice. On a small dais are two thrones with the king and queen seated. Around them stand richly dressed figures—the most powerful nobles and members of the king's dynasty. The court mage, Karadol—a figure in a long cloak with silken cords around the wrists—extends his hands and points to a large magical crystal.*
**Karadol:** "Come here, heroes, place your hands upon the crystal. Once you are connected to the system, we will explain how our world works."

*If you are a male student, you may join the queue for the crystal, but if you are a female student, a group of armored female soldiers will gently but firmly guide you to an adjacent room for an evaluation by the steward...*
(To begin, describe who you were in the class before the summoning and what race you are. Include any friends and connections with other classmates.)
